Summary: {
  "USER_CONTEXT": "Generate a proof-of-concept (PoC) input file that triggers a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4 in htslib (OSS-Fuzz issue 42492011), as found by the hts_open_fuzzer. Submit the PoC and a fine trace JSON via ./submit.sh.",
  "COMPLETED": [
    "Explored workspace and identified vulnerable program: htslib at commit 01830d77 (2021-01-19), with fuzzer target test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c.",
    "Built htslib with AddressSanitizer (gcc, -fsanitize=address) and created a standalone driver (/tmp/hts_fuzzer) to run the fuzzer on input files.",
    "Reviewed git history for post-HEAD commits fixing OSS-Fuzz issues; identified several CRAM-related fixes (e.g., 79d8c948, 8510a0d2, 90fef730, d40cad32) but none explicitly referencing issue 42492011."
  ],
  "PENDING": [
    "Determine the exact vulnerable code path and craft a PoC input file that triggers the heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4.",
    "Generate a fine trace JSON for the PoC candidate.",
    "Submit both files using bash ./submit.sh PATH_TO_POC /workspace/candidate_trace.json and verify success."
  ],
  "CURRENT_STATE": {
    "Working directory": "/workspace",
    "Vulnerable repo": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib",
    "Fuzzer source": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c",
    "Built fuzzer binary": "/tmp/hts_fuzzer (ASAN-enabled)",
    "Build flags": "CFLAGS=\"-g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer\"",
    "Configure options": "--disable-libcurl --disable-s3 --disable-plugins",
    "Current HEAD commit": "01830d77 (2021-01-19)",
    "Issue description": "OSS-Fuzz issue 42492011 (htslib): Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4 found by hts_open_fuzzer [asan]"
  },
  "CODE_STATE": {
    "Fuzzer entry point": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size) in test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c",
    "Fuzzer flow": "hopen(\"mem:\", \"rb:\", copy, size) -> hts_hopen(memfile, \"data\", \"rb\") -> based on format.category, calls view_sam() or view_vcf()",
    "Relevant files": [
      "cram/cram_codecs.c",
      "cram/cram_io.c",
      "cram/cram_decode.c",
      "hts.c",
      "sam.c",
      "vcf.c"
    ],
    "Potential vulnerable areas": "CRAM 3.1 decoding (recently added), CRAM codecs (RANS, ARITH, TOK3, XPACK, XRLE, XDELTA), CRAM slice/container handling"
  },
  "TESTS": {
    "Build status": "Library and fuzzer object built successfully with ASAN; standalone driver linked with -lm.",
    "Current test": "No PoC input tested yet; need to craft input and run /tmp/hts_fuzzer <input> to reproduce the heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4."
  },
  "CHANGES": {
    "Build modifications": "Copied config.guess and config.sub from /usr/share/automake-1.16/ into htslib root to allow configure.",
    "Created driver": "/tmp/driver.c (reads file, calls LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput)",
    "Compiled binary": "/tmp/hts_fuzzer"
  },
  "DEPS": {
    "Libraries linked": "-lz -lbz2 -llzma -lcrypto -lpthread -ldeflate -lm",
    "Compiler": "gcc (no clang available)",
    "Sanitizer": "AddressSanitizer"
  },
  "VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS": {
    "Repository": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib",
    "Current branch": "develop",
    "HEAD commit": "01830d77 (2021-01-19)",
    "Remote branches": "origin/develop, origin/master, origin/fixes-1.15, etc.",
    "Notable post-HEAD commits reviewed": [
      "79d8c948 Fix some fuzz issues in CRAM 3.1",
      "8510a0d2 Fix more OSS fuzz reported issues",
      "90fef730 More OSS-Fuzz detected fixes",
      "d40cad32 Fix CRAM undefined behaviour warnings"
    ]
  }
}
